title: Quantified Boolean satisfiability
variant: Closed prenex quantified Boolean formulas with a fixed number of alternating quantifier blocks
task: Decide whether the formula is true.
encoding: Explicit quantifier prefix and matrix. n counts variables occurring in the matrix.
parameter: Treewidth t of the primal graph
coverage: The fixed-block primal-treewidth lower bound of Fichte, Hecher, and Pfandler.

inputConditions.condition: The matrix is in 3-CNF if the last quantifier is existential and in 3-DNF if it is universal.

reader.parameterLabel: Primal treewidth at fixed quantifier depth
reader.parameter: The treewidth t of the primal graph. Its vertices are the variables, and two variables are adjacent if they occur together in a clause or term.

symbols.meaning: number of variables in the matrix
a tower of q powers of two with x at the top, so T(1,x)=2^x and T(2,x)=2^(2^x)

reader.boundContext: Here q is the fixed number of quantifier blocks, t is the primal treewidth, and n is the number of variables in the matrix. T(q,x) is a tower of q powers of two with x at the top, so T(1,x)=2^x and T(2,x)=2^(2^x).

bounds.statement: Under ETH, no deterministic algorithm decides Quantified Boolean satisfiability within the stated running time.

sources.locator: Theorem 13, proceedings pp. 417 and 421 (PDF pp. 8 and 12)

reader.label: Tower bound at fixed quantifier depth
